editorial.hero_description: Design-driven luxury and lively energy steps from the shell-strewn sands of Playa Conchal.
editorial.description: A vibrant 5-star W-branded beach resort set within Reserva Conchal, featuring 152 rooms with ocean views, three restaurants, a full spa and an infinity pool. It blends design-forward energy with access to Playa Conchal and a wide range of watersports and activities.

why_stay_here.title: Why Stay Here
why_stay_here.summary: W Costa Rica Resort – Playa Conchal is one of the best places to stay if you want to combine comfort with unforgettable experiences around Guanacaste.

wild_insights.local_take: Ideal for style-conscious travelers who want a scene, a spa and a wide slate of activities without leaving the resort. Families are well served too, with a kids' club and childcare on site.

faq.q: What room types does W Costa Rica Resort offer?
faq.a: The resort has 152 rooms across Premier, Superior and Deluxe categories, all with king beds and many with ocean views and private balconies.

faq.q: Does the resort have a spa?
faq.a: Guests can enjoy a full-service spa with steam room, jacuzzi, massages, facials, body scrubs and manicures and pedicures.
Yes, the resort offers a kids' club, a children's play area and childcare services, making it suitable for families.
